withAccessAssessments.rationale: The accepted work leaves the canonical objective open and adds one specialized converse package. About 160 root-local hours cover comparison with the best achievability and converse benchmarks, integration of any resulting bound, and decisions about activating independent packages; no child-local reduction, inequality, or optimization work is included.

With the accepted proofs and exact witness available, a competent researcher can start directly from the unresolved bottlenecks. The estimate allocates roughly 180 hours to a structure-preserving compactness or support analysis, 180 hours to exact binary-posterior or jointly consistent channel constraints, and 160 hours to certified optimization and proof assembly. Incidence 0.55 reflects that the route is credible because it is induced by every deterministic code and leaves channel-specific refinements viable, but its blocklength-growing auxiliaries and the entropy/copy no-go create a substantial chance that the portfolio instead emphasizes other routes.

response.topologyRationale: The two semantic results are separately reusable but belong to one smallest durable work-policy package: the no-go result depends on the code-induced structure and prunes one refinement mechanism within the same continue-or-prune converse decision. Their mathematical dependency does not justify two programs because no credible intervention makes their remaining pursuit, stopping rule, or direct residual work vary independently. The package is rooted directly under the canonical program because no narrower pre-existing activation gate exists.
